scope: Before any new201-dimensional gate is fitted or flown: correct conditional mixture semantics; existing labeled options unchanged.
change: Mixture conditioning weights each member by its base-success probability, computed in log space. A near-zero base-success probability does not erase conditional harm. Ensemble disagreement remains heuristic, not a frequentist confidence interval.
diagnostic_controls: weighted-conditional mean plus member standard deviation
maximum conditional harm across ensemble members
native_raw_short_pulse_controls: Predeclared using training-only label support; no new final-test route inspected.
proof: Counterexample tests for unequal p_B member weights and underflow at base logit -1000.
actor_scope: All five frozen GTrXL proposers may be compared on development; a chosen proposer or combination is fixed before final tests. Gate-fit replicas and proposer variation must be reported separately.
